cleavage_agent: samples were dried (Eppendorf, Concentrator plus), resuspended in 8 M urea, reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin (Promega).
collision_energy: most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to 'peptide' were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
enrichment_method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column
fractionation_method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column
fragmentation_method: most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to 'peptide' were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
